{"metadata":{"description":"Codex-style Side Chat for DeepSeek Harness — select text, ask follow-up questions in a focused side conversation, and keep the main chat uninterrupted.","id":"gh:1333810473","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-side-chat","slug":"AHGGG/dsh-side-chat","topics":["codex","codex-desktop","dsh","dsh-plugin","side-chat","sidechat"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codex-style Side Chat for DeepSeek Harness — select text, ask follow-up questions in a focused side "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"conversation, and keep the main chat uninterrupted."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-side-chat"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Ask a focused follow-up about selected text without leaving your current conversation in **DeepSeek "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"Harness Desktop or Web**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Use a Side Chat version that matches your DSH runtime:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Side Chat | DeepSeek Harness runtime |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `@ahggg/dsh-side-chat@1.0.3` | `0.2.1-rc.2` |
| `@ahggg/dsh-side-chat@1.0.2` | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| `@"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ahggg/dsh-side-chat@1.0.1` | `0.2.0-rc.1` |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The instructions below use **Side Chat 1.0.3 with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**. If you are staying on an older D"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"SH runtime, keep the matching Side Chat version from the table until you upgrade."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Keep DSH's plugin compatibility check enabled rather than bypassing it."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness Desktop"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"In DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`, open the plugin installation dialog and enter the complete"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`, open the plugin installation dialog and enter the complete package spec:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install it, then restart DeepSeek Harness Desktop. Use the Desktop app's plugin manager for Desktop "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"installations; the CLI commands below target the Web profile."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Web (`dsh web`)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Install the matching DSH CLI if needed, then install the pinned plugin version:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Start DSH from the project you want the agent to work in:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Open the URL printed by DSH. The plugin loads automatically in the Web client."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Local linked development"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"When `dsh plugin --profile web list` shows the plugin coming from a `link:` workspace, DSH loads the"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" committed `lib/client.js`, not `src/`. Rebuild after switching branches or changing client source, "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"then restart the `dsh web` process:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Use Side Chat"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"On phones and tablets, long-press text in a completed message to select it. The Side Chat action bar"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" appears below the selection when there is room, leaving the browser's native selection bar above it"},{"id":"p25s3","text":". Use `Add to chat`, `More details`, or `Ask in side chat` directly from the touch action bar."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"1. Complete at least one turn in the main conversation.
2. Select text inside one completed user or "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"assistant message.
3. Click `Add to chat` to add an optional comment before attaching the passage to"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" the main composer, `More details` to send an explanation request immediately, or `Ask in side chat`"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" to write a focused question.
4. When writing your own message or question, press `Enter` to send it"},{"id":"p26s5","text":".
5. After a Side Chat reply settles, click `Add to conversation` to attach that focused discussion "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"to the main composer as one conversation reference.
6. Click `×`, or press `Esc` while focused insid"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"e the Side Chat panel, when you are done. Escape in another composer or menu does not close Side Cha"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"the Side Chat panel, when you are done. Escape in another composer or menu does not close Side Chat."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Useful details:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline.
- Use the model control beside Send, then **Effort**, to choose t"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"he model's thinking level. You can change it while a reply runs: that reply keeps its original setti"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ngs, while the accepted choice applies to the next reply and is remembered for future **Ask in side "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"chat** and **More details** requests in this client. It does not change the main conversation.
- Aft"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"er clicking `Add to chat`, press `Enter` or click `Save` to keep the annotation. Click outside the c"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"omment box or click `Cancel` to discard it.
- `Add to chat` keeps any existing draft text and can co"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"llect multiple numbered passages, each with its own optional comment, in one annotation capsule.
- `"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"Add to conversation` captures the Side Chat's user/assistant history, preserves the main draft, and "},{"id":"p28s9","text":"refreshes the existing reference instead of duplicating it when clicked again.
- The input grows wit"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"h its content and becomes scrollable at its maximum height.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## What happens to the conversation"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`Ask in side chat` and `More details` use direct, streaming model calls through DSH's configured pro"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"vider. On the first send, the plugin captures a **read-only text snapshot** of the parent conversati"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"on through the selected message's completed turn. Later parent prompts are excluded, and this contex"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"t stays fixed for follow-ups. Opening the draft alone makes no model call."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Side Chat keeps its own temporary message history in memory. It does **not** fork, copy, create, or "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"archive a DSH Session, run an Agent, or write a Session event log. It has **no tools, command execut"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ion, or file-editing capability**. Parent reasoning and image/file attachment bytes are omitted; his"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"torical tool text is only reference material. The initial model uses the saved Side Chat choice, or "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"the selected parent turn's configuration. Changing it affects only subsequent Side Chat replies."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Closing the panel, reloading/disconnecting the client, or unloading the plugin cancels active work a"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"nd discards the temporary discussion. Host records also expire after 30 minutes idle. To keep a disc"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ussion, use **Add to conversation**, then **send the parent draft** to store the reference in the pa"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"rent history. Adding a reference alone does not send it. References already added to the parent draf"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"t are separate from the temporary panel and survive its closure."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The text snapshot and Side Chat history are sent to the model on each request, so normal provider to"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ken usage still applies; avoiding Session copies does not eliminate context tokens or guarantee cach"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"e reuse. Archived Sessions created by older plugin versions are not automatically deleted."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Current limitations"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- A selection must stay inside one completed message.
- This is a text-only, read-only discussion, n"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ot a second Agent. Attachments, tools, Steer, and `/side` are not supported.
- Closed or expired dis"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"cussions cannot be reopened. There is no “keep as normal Session” action.
- Context is limited to 2,"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"097,152 characters and rejected rather than silently truncated. Each question is limited to 65,536 c"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"haracters; each reply (including reasoning) to 262,144 characters. A discussion permits at most 64 q"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"uestions and 2,097,152 question/reply/reasoning characters. Output limits produce an explicit error "},{"id":"p35s7","text":"and keep only the displayed partial reply.
- Model requests time out after two minutes. Provider-spe"},{"id":"p35s8","text":"cific context/output limits may be lower."}],"truncated":true}
